svg.title: Botons, set up my way
svg.desc: A dark terminal-style setup screen. At the top, a blocky figure labelled Me: I set up each Boton, its brain, its role, its tools, and how it works. In the middle, a round, button-shaped Boton with a green antenna, with its own chat, memory and workspace. Four numbered panels plug into it with green wires. One, brain or model: Claude Code is selected, with Codex and a model on my own Anthropic or OpenAI API key as the other choices, plus spending caps on API keys. Two, role and instructions: the role chief of staff and a box of instructions in my words. Three, tools: switches for a T3 fleet gateway and GitHub turned on, Linear and the managed browser off, only the connectors I give it. Four, workflow: skills from my library, a routine every 15 minutes or when a webhook calls, and Ask first before risky steps. Below, my team, mix and match per Boton: three Botons for research on Claude Code, review on Codex, and inbox on an API key.
svg.text: its brain, its role, its tools,
a model on my API key
only the connectors I give it
